ranked.headline: Fast, accurate decoders for qLDPC and surface codes target real-time fault tolerance
ranked.summary: A run of preprints pushes qLDPC and surface-code decoding toward sub-microsecond latency while matching or beating BP+OSD, Relay-BP and Tesseract accuracy.

ranked.headline: Nonlocal correlations and dissipation reshape topology, symmetry breaking and sensing
ranked.summary: Recent preprints use correlation structure in open and monitored many-body dynamics to diagnose transitions, non-Markovianity and metrological gain.

ranked.headline: Forward models and EFTs tighten control of nonlinear and astrophysical LSS systematics
ranked.summary: Simulation-validated EFT, n(z), baryonification and lens-multipole studies target biases that would limit DESI, Euclid, SKA and time-delay cosmology.

ranked.headline: Rethinking how quantum learning models are trained, measured, and fed data
ranked.summary: Eight November 2026 preprints target optimizers, shot budgets, noise calibration and input encoding for variational and reservoir-style quantum learning models.

ranked.headline: Engineering states, controls and Hamiltonians to push quantum sensing beyond standard limits
ranked.summary: Recent preprints target scaling limits in sensing: super-Heisenberg time-dependent estimation, robust hypergraph probes, k-local thermometry, sqrt(N) spectroscopy.

ranked.headline: Post-DESI analyses test evolving dark energy against ΛCDM with parametric and non-parametric reconstructions
ranked.summary: DESI-era data are driving model comparisons and reconstructions that favor dynamical dark energy, with phantom-divide crossing near z≈0.5–0.7.

ranked.headline: Compilers and simulators target hardware cost: latency, routing, depth, and classical scalability
ranked.summary: Preprints tie circuit compilation to physical costs like pulse latency and two-qubit count, alongside scalable classical simulation for near-Clifford and Pauli workloads.

ranked.headline: Altermagnetic and noncoplanar order probed via optical, spin-current and magnon responses
ranked.summary: Seven preprints extend unconventional magnetism to quasicrystals, optical octupole probes, and nonlinear spin responses, alongside magnon-based transport proposals.

ranked.headline: Euclid DR1 documents survey coverage, photometry, masks, photo-z properties and spectroscopic redshifts
ranked.summary: Six companion preprints dated 12–13 November 2026 document Euclid's first data release, covering survey status, validation and processing pipelines.

ranked.headline: Fast, differentiable nonlinear models and pipelines are being readied for LSST-era cosmology
ranked.summary: Preprints on emulators, differentiable bispectra, cluster pipelines and GW sirens target LSST Year 1 and next-generation analyses.

ranked.headline: Laser pulses and electrical stimuli write and switch skyrmions and compensated magnetic order
ranked.summary: Recent preprints show picosecond optical writing of ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic skyrmions, alongside advances in all-optical switching and compensated-order readout.

ranked.headline: Symmetry and structure are built into quantum and tensor-network algorithms to cut cost on hardware
ranked.summary: Six preprints from mid-November 2026 embed spin, charge, Clifford or RG structure into quantum diagonalization, state loading and ground-state search.

ranked.headline: Reduced-subspace and compact-ansatz methods target strongly correlated electronic and spin systems
ranked.summary: Six preprints from 12–17 November 2026 span quantum-hardware subspace methods and classical wavefunction closures for strong correlation.

ranked.headline: Matching upper and lower bounds sharpen quantum query, learning, and memory-advantage results
ranked.summary: Six preprints from 12–16 Nov establish tight or exact quantum bounds spanning query complexity, graph-state learning, and state-over-time cones.

ranked.headline: Euclid DR1 documents NIR, spectroscopic and ground-based calibration underpinning first-release data products
ranked.summary: A set of Euclid DR1 papers released 12 November 2026 documents the processing and calibration chains behind the first cosmology-grade data release.

ranked.headline: Resonant nanoantennas and metasurfaces tailor nonlinear, magnetic, chiral and THz optical responses
ranked.summary: Five preprints show resonant nano-photonic structures delivering UV harmonic enhancement, high-Q chirality, and record THz dynamic range.

ranked.headline: Environment-dependent galaxy and transient populations tested against LCDM and evolutionary expectations
ranked.summary: Four November 2026 preprints probe how environment shapes satellites, cluster-core SNe Ia, BCG dominance and radio-loud AGN incidence across cosmic time.

ranked.headline: Josephson junction current-phase relations and materials are being engineered for qubit design
ranked.summary: Four preprints dated 12-13 November 2026 address non-sinusoidal, nanowire, and Ge-based junctions as building blocks for superconducting and Andreev qubits.

ranked.headline: Learned and field-level methods reconstruct IGM, cluster mass, and large-scale density fields
ranked.summary: Four preprints in mid-November 2026 apply neural and likelihood-based reconstruction to Lyα, lensing, and galaxy-survey data.

ranked.headline: Disordered and unconventional magnetic ground states reassessed via neural-network, geometric and ab initio approaches
ranked.summary: Four preprints revisit spin-liquid character, narrow-band magnetism and oxide gaps, reframing how ordered and disordered magnetic states are identified.

ranked.headline: Engineered spectral selectivity in solar-thermal absorbers and thermal emitters
ranked.summary: Recent preprints model spectrally selective multilayer, metasurface, and photonic emitters and absorbers, alongside solar-spectrum property databases.

ranked.headline: Controlling optical modes in imaging, nonlinear crystals, and quantum microscopy
ranked.summary: Recent preprints address mode preservation, quantization-error correction, nonlinear domain design, and quantum interference microscopy.

ranked.headline: CMB polarization constrains photon birefringence and Lorentz violation
ranked.summary: SPT-3G sets A_CB<0.027 and Simons Observatory and LiteBIRD forecasts sharpen CMB tests of photon propagation beyond standard electrodynamics.

ranked.headline: Coherent and unitary photonic circuits target higher-bandwidth optical computing
ranked.summary: Recent preprints report 103.96 Tb/s on-chip coherent-lite links and parameter-efficient unitary layers for coherent optical neural networks.

ranked.headline: Layer-dependent disorder shapes Chern plateau widths in twisted bilayer MoTe2
ranked.summary: Recent preprints examine how disorder and scattering shape Hall plateaus, orbital Hall response, and anisotropic magnetotransport in topological materials.

ranked.headline: Interband coherence and quantum metric govern optical spin responses in 2D systems
ranked.summary: Recent preprints present analytical and frequency-dependent theory of light-induced spin and magnetization responses in altermagnets and graphene.

ranked.headline: Non-Hermitian edges reshape edge states, mobility edges, and temporal routing
ranked.summary: Three new preprints probe how non-Hermitian asymmetry and nonlinearity reshape edge-localized states beyond conventional bulk-boundary expectations.

ranked.headline: Correlated electron crystallization and competing orders in two-dimensional systems
ranked.summary: Recent preprints examine crystallization and competing phases in 2D electron systems across bilayers, quantum wells, and graphene.

ranked.headline: Optical and electrostatic probes reveal internal fields in nitride and diamond devices
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply optical spectroscopy and electrostatic modeling to quantify non-uniform internal fields and doping in AlGaN, MoSe2 and diamond devices.

ranked.headline: Nonlinear and electro-optic sources enable new spectroscopy platforms
ranked.summary: Three November 2026 preprints report advances in silicon, fiber, and organic-crystal nonlinear optical sources.

ranked.headline: Optimized design of structured light via zone plates, metasurfaces, skyrmion polarimetry
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply explicit optimization and predictive design frameworks to flying-focus, moiré metasurface, and skyrmionic polarimetry problems.

ranked.headline: Intensity modulation and Floquet driving tune optomechanical backaction in resonators
ranked.summary: Recent preprints report modulated optical drives reaching cavity-bandwidth amplitude limits and sub-quantum-backaction cooling.
